links.text: No power, no crank or the engine will not start A Mercedes no-start can involve the 12-volt supply, starter circuit, key authorisation, fuel, ignition, engine-speed input or another control fault. The first step is to identify whether the car has no power, will not crank or cranks without starting. Read the Mercedes no-start guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Suspension Fault or one side sitting low On a Mercedes fitted with AIRMATIC, a low corner or warning can involve an air spring, compressor, valve block, leak, sensor or electrical fault. Confirm the fitted system before testing; ABC and E-ACTIVE BODY CONTROL use different procedures. Understand the AIRMATIC warning

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Jerking, slipping or delayed gear engagement 7G-Tronic, 9G-Tronic and AMG SpeedShift symptoms may relate to fluid condition, adaptations, sensors, a conductor plate, mechatronics or internal wear. A scan and road test help define the repair scope. Read the gearbox symptom guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Engine light, rough idle or loss of power The cause can sit in ignition, air metering, boost, fuel delivery, emissions or cooling—not just the component named by a stored code. XENTRY data and physical testing are used together. Read the check-engine guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Weak AC, warm air or uneven cabin cooling Poor cabin cooling needs airflow, refrigerant-pressure, leak and climate-control checks. A recharge is appropriate only after the cause and correct refrigerant specification are established. Read the weak-AC guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Overheating or repeated coolant loss A rising temperature warning concerns engine cooling. Stop safely if overheating is indicated, allow the system to cool and arrange assessment; do not open a hot coolant cap or keep driving to test the warning. Read the engine-overheating guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Battery warning or intermittent electrical faults A weak main or auxiliary battery, charging fault, voltage drop, wiring concern or control-module communication issue can create several warning messages at once. Any required battery registration or coding is confirmed for compatibility and quoted where supported. Read the battery-warning guide

links.class: card-premium group rounded-2xl p-5 sm:p-6
links.text: Brake warning, vibration or reduced confidence Mercedes and AMG brake checks cover pad and disc condition, sensors, calipers, fluid, hydraulic operation and the cause of vibration. The correct parts route depends on the fitted brake package. Mercedes brake repair

mainEntity.name: Where can I find a Mercedes specialist in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Digi-Tec Performance Centre is an independent workshop in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai. Mercedes owners can request scheduled maintenance, diagnostics or mechanical, transmission, suspension, AC, brake and electrical work; exact scope is confirmed for the vehicle.

mainEntity.name: How often should a Mercedes-Benz be serviced in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Follow the ASSYST service reminder and the interval specified for the exact model and year. Dubai heat, traffic, dust, mileage and driving pattern can justify additional inspections or earlier fluid attention, so we confirm the scope from the vehicle rather than applying one interval to every Mercedes.

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between Mercedes Service A and Service B?

acceptedAnswer.text: Service A is generally the smaller scheduled visit, while Service B adds a wider set of inspections and service items. The exact checklist varies by model, age, mileage and the ASSYST display, so the VIN and service history should be checked before quoting.

mainEntity.name: Do you use genuine Mercedes-Benz parts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Parts are selected for the exact Mercedes-Benz VIN, repair and agreed quotation. Depending on availability and the job, the estimate may specify a genuine part, an established OE-supplier component or another suitable customer-approved option; no source is assumed before it is confirmed.

mainEntity.name: How long does Mercedes repair or service take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mercedes-Benz workshop time depends on the exact model, inspection findings, parts availability and any supported calibration or road testing. The expected timeline is confirmed after the vehicle and required work are reviewed.

mainEntity.name: Do you repair Mercedes AIRMATIC suspension faults?

acceptedAnswer.text: AIRMATIC, ABC and E-ACTIVE symptoms such as one side sitting low, slow lifting, compressor noise, harsh ride and suspension warnings can be inspected. The cause and available repair scope are confirmed for the vehicle before replacement is recommended.

mainEntity.name: Can you diagnose 7G-Tronic and 9G-Tronic transmission problems?

acceptedAnswer.text: Delayed engagement, jerking, slipping, leaks and transmission warnings can be assessed using the checks supported by the vehicle, with a road test where appropriate. The repair scope is confirmed after inspection.

mainEntity.name: Which Mercedes models do you repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Appointments can be requested for A-Class, C-Class, E-Class, S-Class, CLA, CLS, GLA, GLB, GLC, GLE, GLS, G-Class, AMG models, selected EQ vehicles and V-Class. Send the VIN and concern so model, system and parts coverage can be confirmed before booking.

mainEntity.name: Is Digi-Tec a Mercedes garage in Al Quoz, Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. The workshop is in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai. The Mercedes page includes a direct Google Maps link, phone number and WhatsApp booking option.

mainEntity.name: متى تحتاج مرسيدس إلى الصيانة في دبي؟

acceptedAnswer.text: يعتمد الموعد والأعمال المستحقة على بيانات السيارة ومؤشر ASSYST وسجل الصيانة وتعليمات الطراز. نراجع ظروف الاستخدام والحالة الفعلية دون فرض فترة واحدة على جميع السيارات.

mainEntity.name: ما الفرق بين Service A وService B؟

acceptedAnswer.text: يشير كل منهما إلى زيارة صيانة، لكن البنود الدقيقة تعتمد على الطراز والعمر والمسافة والأعمال السابقة. نوضح الزيت والفلاتر والفحوص والعناصر الإضافية في عرض السعر.

mainEntity.name: هل تختلف صيانة AMG عن فئات مرسيدس الأخرى؟

acceptedAnswer.text: قد تختلف المحركات والقير والفرامل والتعليق والسوائل حسب الجيل والتجهيزات. نتحقق من رقم الهيكل ومواصفات السيارة؛ ولا نعامل حزمة AMG الشكلية كأنها طراز Mercedes-AMG كامل.

mainEntity.name: هل تؤكدون القطع والتكلفة قبل الإصلاح؟

acceptedAnswer.text: نوضح القطع المقترحة ومطابقتها للسيارة وأجرة العمل ونطاق الفحص قبل التنفيذ. تحتاج النتائج الإضافية إلى توضيح وموافقة قبل توسيع العمل.

mainEntity.name: كيف أحجز وكم تستغرق الخدمة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: الورشة في القوز الصناعية 3، دبي. اتصل أو راسلنا على ‎+971 4 340 2223 مع بيانات السيارة. نؤكد الموعد والمدة المتوقعة بحسب الفحص وتوفر القطع.

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no single interval for every vehicle. Start with the schedule for the exact model, then consider age, mileage, recorded history, warning messages, and Dubai driving conditions. Contact the workshop if you need help confirming the appropriate inspection or service.

mainEntity.name: What are signs my vehicle needs immediate attention?

acceptedAnswer.text: Warning lights, rough idling, overheating, shifting delays, unusual noise, or reduced efficiency are reasons to arrange an inspection. The appropriate diagnostic steps depend on the vehicle and symptoms.

mainEntity.name: What makes DIGI-TEC different from regular garages?

acceptedAnswer.text: DIGI-TEC is an independent Dubai workshop established in 2002, focused on European, luxury, and performance vehicles. The team inspects the vehicle, explains the proposed scope, and seeks approval before work begins.

mainEntity.name: Can you repair hybrid and electric luxury cars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Support depends on the exact model, system, and work required. Send the vehicle model, year, and concern so the team can confirm the currently available inspection and repair scope before booking.

mainEntity.name: What is included in a car service in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The scope depends on the exact vehicle and scheduled service. It may include oil and filter replacement, fluid checks, brake and tyre inspection, battery testing, and other model-specific items. The agreed work should be listed before service begins.

mainEntity.name: How often should I service my car in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Use the schedule for the exact model and consider the vehicle's age, mileage, service history, driving pattern, and Dubai conditions. A workshop should explain any recommendation rather than apply one interval to every car.

mainEntity.name: Do luxury cars like Mercedes, BMW, and Audi need special servicing?

acceptedAnswer.text: These vehicles can require model-specific fluids, parts, diagnostic steps, and reset or calibration procedures. Send the exact model, year, and requested work so the workshop can confirm the available service scope and proposed specification.

mainEntity.name: How much does car service cost in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Cost depends on the vehicle, inspection findings, labour scope, and parts or fluids selected. Request an estimate that identifies the proposed work and confirm it before approval.

mainEntity.name: How long does a car service take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the exact vehicle, scheduled work, inspection findings, parts availability, and any additional work the owner approves. Ask the workshop to confirm the expected timing for your booking.

mainEntity.name: Where can I find a reliable car service near me in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: Digi-Tec Performance Center is an independent European and luxury car workshop in Al Quoz Industrial Area 3, Dubai. Contact the team with your model and requested service to confirm an appointment.

mainEntity.name: What happens if I skip car servicing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Skipping regular car servicing can lead to engine damage, reduced fuel efficiency, brake wear, and costly repairs over time. Regular maintenance ensures your vehicle remains safe, efficient, and reliable.

mainEntity.name: Do you service Ferrari and other performance cars?

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the workshop with the exact brand, model, year, mileage, and requested work. The team will confirm the currently available inspection or service scope before booking.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer ECU tuning and power upgrades?

acceptedAnswer.text: Performance work depends on the exact vehicle, current specification, mechanical condition, and intended use. Send those details so the team can confirm available tuning or upgrade options and any inspection required first.

mainEntity.name: Can you repair AMG models?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send the exact AMG model, year, mileage, and concern so the workshop can confirm the available inspection, repair, or performance-work scope before booking.

mainEntity.name: Why is my car AC not cooling in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The most common reasons are low refrigerant, leaks, or a failing compressor. In Dubai's heat, even a small issue can significantly reduce cooling performance.

mainEntity.name: Can I just refill AC gas and fix the problem?

acceptedAnswer.text: Not always. If the refrigerant is low due to a leak, simply refilling it will only fix the issue temporarily. The leak must be identified and repaired for a permanent solution.

mainEntity.name: How do I know if my AC compressor is failing?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs include weak cooling, unusual noises when the AC is on, or the AC stopping completely. In some cases, the compressor may still run but not efficiently.

mainEntity.name: How often should I service my car AC in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: There is no universal AC interval for every vehicle. Arrange an inspection when cooling weakens, noise appears, or the system behaves unusually, and consider a condition check before the hottest months based on the vehicle's history.

mainEntity.name: Do luxury cars require special AC repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: AC system design varies by model and can include electronic controls, multiple zones, and vehicle-specific components. The workshop should confirm the exact system and required diagnostic process before recommending work.

mainEntity.name: How long does AC repair take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Timing depends on the diagnosis, leak testing, required parts, and approved repair scope. The workshop can estimate timing after the vehicle and system have been assessed.

mainEntity.name: Does my car AC get damaged if I drive with the windows down in hot weather?

acceptedAnswer.text: Driving with the windows down while the AC is running will not directly damage your air conditioning system, but it does force it to work much harder. In Dubai's extreme heat, hot air continuously enters the cabin, meaning the AC has to run at maximum capacity for longer periods. Over time, this added strain can accelerate wear on the compressor and reduce overall efficiency. Occasional use is fine, but keeping windows closed maintains optimal performance and reduces unnecessary load on the system.

acceptedAnswer.text: Contact the team to confirm whether pickup or drop-off is available for your location, requested service, and appointment time.

mainEntity.name: Can I visit the workshop from outside Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: تشمل عادةً تغيير زيت المحرك والفلتر، وفحص السوائل والفرامل والبطارية والإطارات، إضافة إلى فحص عام وفق جدول الشركة المصنّعة.

mainEntity.name: كم تستغرق الصيانة الدورية؟

acceptedAnswer.text: تعتمد المدة على السيارة ونطاق الخدمة ونتائج الفحص وتوفر القطع وأي أعمال إضافية يوافق عليها المالك. اطلب تأكيد الوقت المتوقع عند الحجز.

mainEntity.name: هل تحتاج مرسيدس وبي إم دبليو وأودي إلى خدمة متخصصة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: قد تحتاج هذه السيارات إلى سوائل وقطع وخطوات فحص وإعادة ضبط تختلف حسب الطراز. أرسل نوع السيارة وسنة الصنع والعمل المطلوب لتأكيد نطاق الخدمة المتاح.

mainEntity.name: هل تخدمون فيراري وغيرها من سيارات الأداء؟

acceptedAnswer.text: أرسل العلامة والطراز والسنة والمسافة والعمل المطلوب لنتأكد من نطاق الفحص أو الخدمة المتاح قبل الحجز.

mainEntity.name: هل تقدمون برمجة ECU وزيادة القوة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: يعتمد العمل المتاح على السيارة ومواصفاتها الحالية وحالتها الميكانيكية والاستخدام المطلوب. أرسل التفاصيل لنتأكد من الخيارات المتاحة والفحص المطلوب أولاً.

mainEntity.name: هل تعملون على طرازات AMG؟

acceptedAnswer.text: أرسل طراز AMG والسنة والمسافة ووصف المشكلة أو العمل المطلوب لنتأكد من نطاق الفحص أو الإصلاح أو الأداء المتاح قبل الحجز.

acceptedAnswer.text: قد يكون السبب نقص غاز التبريد، أو تسريباً، أو ضعف الضاغط، أو خللاً كهربائياً. نبدأ بالفحص لتحديد السبب قبل تعبئة الغاز أو تغيير القطع.

mainEntity.name: هل تعبئة الغاز وحدها تحل المشكلة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: ليس دائماً. إذا كان هناك تسريب فستكون التعبئة حلاً مؤقتاً، ويجب تحديد مصدر التسريب وإصلاحه.

mainEntity.name: كم مرة يجب فحص تكييف السيارة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: لا توجد فترة واحدة تناسب كل سيارة. اطلب الفحص عند ضعف التبريد أو ظهور صوت أو سلوك غير طبيعي، ويمكن مناقشة فحص الحالة قبل أشهر الحر بحسب سجل السيارة.

mainEntity.name: هل تقدمون خدمة استلام وتسليم السيارة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: تواصل مع الفريق للتأكد من توفر خدمة الاستلام أو التسليم لموقعك وموعدك قبل الحجز.

mainEntity.name: هل يمكن زيارة الورشة من خارج دبي؟

acceptedAnswer.text: تقع الورشة في القوز الصناعية 3 بدبي. اتصل قبل السفر لتأكيد موعد الفحص والخدمة المطلوبة.

mainEntity.name: What if my Mercedes has no complete service history?

acceptedAnswer.text: Gather the invoices and service information available, then compare them with the requirements for the exact vehicle. A workshop can identify confirmed work, gaps in the record and items needing inspection before recommending catch-up maintenance.

mainEntity.name: Does low mileage mean I can postpone maintenance?

acceptedAnswer.text: Mileage is only part of the plan. Check time-based requirements, storage guidance and the actual condition of the car. A service reminder or low odometer reading does not replace that review.

mainEntity.name: Should every inspection finding become an immediate repair?

acceptedAnswer.text: Ask which finding is confirmed, what makes it urgent and what can reasonably be monitored. Request the next review point and the warning signs that should bring the car back sooner. Follow any immediate-action instructions for a safety warning.

mainEntity.name: What records should I keep after the appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Keep the dated invoice, mileage, parts and fluid details, completed checks, diagnosis findings and any outstanding recommendations. The records should distinguish work performed from quotations or work that was declined.

mainEntity.name: Which oil does my Mercedes need?

acceptedAnswer.text: The required Mercedes-Benz approval and fill quantity are confirmed from the exact engine and vehicle data. Viscosity alone does not establish that an oil is suitable.

mainEntity.name: Is an oil change the same as Service A or Service B?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. An oil and filter change may be part of the scheduled work, but the service display, vehicle schedule and history determine the other due items.

mainEntity.name: How much does a Mercedes oil change cost in Dubai?

acceptedAnswer.text: The engine, required MB oil approval and quantity, filter, seals, labour and any separately approved due items determine the price. Send the VIN and mileage for an itemized quote.

mainEntity.name: How long does a Mercedes oil change take?

acceptedAnswer.text: Workshop time depends on the engine, oil capacity, filter availability, inspection findings and current schedule. The expected completion time is confirmed with the quote before booking.

mainEntity.name: Is an ASSYST service reset included?

acceptedAnswer.text: A supported reset is performed only for the maintenance actually completed and where the exact vehicle supports the available procedure. Digital service-record access, if requested, is confirmed separately.

mainEntity.name: What should I send for a quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: Send the VIN or model and year, engine if known, mileage, service-display message and any oil warning or leak. The workshop confirms scope and availability before booking.

mainEntity.name: ما الزيت المناسب لمرسيدس؟

acceptedAnswer.text: نحتاج إلى بيانات المحرك ورقم الهيكل لتأكيد موافقة الزيت والكمية. تشابه اللزوجة على عبوتين لا يعني أن الزيتين يلبيان متطلبات المحرك نفسه.

mainEntity.name: هل تغيير الزيت هو نفسه Service A أو Service B؟

acceptedAnswer.text: لا. قد تشمل الخدمة الدورية الزيت والفلتر وفحوصاً وبنوداً أخرى يحددها جدول السيارة ورسالة الخدمة وتاريخها. نوضح البنود المستحقة قبل الحجز.

mainEntity.name: هل يتم تصفير رسالة ASSYST بعد الخدمة؟

acceptedAnswer.text: ننفذ التصفير عندما تدعمه السيارة والإجراء المتاح، وللعمل المنجز فقط. أما إمكانية تحديث السجل الرقمي للصيانة فتؤكد بصورة منفصلة عند طلبها.

mainEntity.name: ما المعلومات المطلوبة للحصول على عرض تغيير الزيت؟

acceptedAnswer.text: أرسل رقم الهيكل أو الموديل والسنة، والمسافة ورسالة الخدمة وأي تحذير أو تسريب. نستخدمها لتحديد المواصفة والكمية ونطاق الفحص المطلوب.

mainEntity.name: Do you support all Mercedes coding and programming requests?

acceptedAnswer.text: No blanket coverage is promised. Support depends on the vehicle, module, requested function, compatible equipment and any required access. The workshop confirms eligibility before booking.

mainEntity.name: Is diagnostic scanning the same as coding?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Scanning retrieves diagnostic information; coding configures supported settings; programming writes compatible software. A wiring or voltage fault may need repair before any software work.

mainEntity.name: Can you diagnose a Mercedes that will not start?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, subject to vehicle access and recovery. The first step is to separate no power, no crank, slow crank, crank-no-start and start-and-stall because each pattern requires different battery, starter, authorization, fuel or engine tests.

mainEntity.name: What affects the cost of Mercedes diagnostics?

acceptedAnswer.text: The complaint, number of systems involved, time needed to reproduce the fault, available module access and required physical or electrical tests determine the diagnostic scope. The initial stage is agreed before further work.

mainEntity.name: Is ECU tuning included?

acceptedAnswer.text: Performance tuning is a separate assessment on the tuning page. A diagnostic or coding request does not establish suitability for a performance software change.

mainEntity.name: Is every G63 fitted with the same transmission?

acceptedAnswer.text: No. Earlier M157-era vehicles use a seven-speed AMG transmission, while the 2018-on M177 platform uses AMG SPEEDSHIFT TCT 9G. The VIN and transmission identification determine the fluid, procedure and diagnostic route.

mainEntity.name: Can a fault code confirm which G63 part has failed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Usually not by itself. A code records a condition seen by a control unit. Live data, wiring or pressure checks, physical inspection and sometimes a controlled road test are needed before a component is condemned.

acceptedAnswer.text: Send Digi-Tec the model year, VIN, mileage, warning message and a clear description of when the symptom occurs. The workshop can then confirm the appropriate first inspection and available appointment.
